You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

A previous incorrect attempt overlooked the 2x2 interior of the second 4x4 frame, so do not assume same-colored duplicate objects are already handled; explicitly verify each box. Additional confirmation (task-10178a90, 2026-10-21): The rule also holds for multiple different border colors and frames of side lengths 3, 4, and 7 in a 28x23 grid: fill strict interiors of odd-sided square outlines with 7 and even-sided square outlines with 2; leave each outline and all background cells unchanged. Correct output filled 3x3 and 7x7 interiors with 7, 4x4 interiors with 2, including a 4x4 outline touching the left grid edge. Accuracy lesson from two incorrect submissions: the rule inference was right; manual input transcription omitted top/bottom border pixels and shifted a few rows near the lower objects. For this pattern, carefully compare the final output line-by-line with the given grid and preserve every border pixel; only modify strict interior cells.

Additional confirmation (task-10178a90): Even outer side lengths 4 (interior 2x2) fill with 2; odd side lengths 3 and 5 (interiors 1x1 and 3x3) fill with 7. Applied across frame colors 3, 4, and 5; preserve borders and background."), ('arc_fill_hollow_rectangles_by_interior_width_parity', 'ARC fill hollow rectangles by interior width parity', 'Continual-ARC pattern confirmed by two demos and one solved test.
